baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three bodily conditions at words 3, 7, and 11 each receive the same negated haraj at words 4, 8, and 12, before the verse resumes with obedience and turning away.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse removes severe constriction and culpability from bodily states while retaining a moral response scaled to actual ability. Because the obedience root also carries capacity, the operative threshold is available responsiveness rather than identical physical performance.

activation_trace.role: Literal loss of sight supplies one concrete limit that cannot fairly be treated as refusal.
Literal lameness supplies impaired locomotion as a second distinct limit on performance.
Weakening and curtailed movement make illness a variable reduction of agency, not a fixed moral type.
Severe narrowness is denied three times, removing a constrictive demand from each body.
The sin-and-scruple image makes the repeated denial an explicit removal of culpability.
Obedient yielding retains moral agency after uniform bodily performance has been waived.
Actual ability supplies the proportional threshold by which obedience can differ across bodies.

changed_reading.before: A list of three compassionate exceptions followed by a generic reward and threat.
changed_reading.after: A differentiated-accountability rule: incapacity cancels constrictive culpability, while whatever responsive agency remains still matters.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse moves from repeated haraj around impaired sight, gait, and health to entry, enclosure, downward space, and flowing rivers.
baseline_models.mechanism: Its two halves form an access topology. Constriction and interrupted movement are cleared; admission then leads into a protected place whose water keeps moving. The reward answers the bodily problem in kind as unobstructed, sustained passage rather than as an unrelated prize.

activation_trace.role: Clustering and entanglement materialize the repeated haraj as crowded blockage.
Bending away from a straight course gives the impaired route a spatial form.
Stopping and lingering supply the temporal interruption that admission reverses.
Literal passage into an interior is the first positive reversal of blockage.
A garden enclosed by growth makes the destination protected without making it confining.
Free running and spreading supply the sustained motion opposite haraj.
Opening and widening until flow is released completes the movement from bottleneck to circulation.

changed_reading.before: Exemption and paradise are adjacent but functionally separate clauses.
changed_reading.after: The paradise clause is a spatial answer to the exemption clause: blocked human routes yield to admitted, protected, continuously flowing life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse names visible bodily deficits but locates the consequential contrast in obeying versus turning away, followed by entry into a concealed interior.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus distinguishes what a body visibly cannot do from an inward orientation that can still consent or withdraw. Blindness can activate loss of insight, while entry and garden carry inwardness and concealment; the verse therefore refuses to infer an obscured heart from an impaired body.

activation_trace.role: Blindness of heart supplies the possible moral condition that the literal blind body must not be presumed to possess.
Diminished clarity makes bodily illness a possible but non-identical analogy for obscured inward judgment.
The inner and secret dimension relocates the decisive axis from outward performance to inward orientation.
Covering and concealment make the promised destination continuous with an unseen moral interior.
Turning the face toward something supplies the live orientation presupposed by the negative form.
Withdrawal and turning the back identify culpable refusal as directional, not somatic.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts disabled people with able people who obey or disobey.
changed_reading.after: It blocks that social contrast: visible impairment is exempted, while the real contrast runs invisibly through every person as orientation or withdrawal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Obedience to a messenger leads through admission into ongoing flow, whereas turning away leads to repeated punishment and pain.
baseline_models.mechanism: A chain of willing response, gentle dispatch, entry, and continuous provision forms a circulation. Turning away breaks the sequence; the punishment root's withholding image lets the negative outcome be read as enforced deprivation from that circulation as well as inflicted pain.

activation_trace.role: The self becoming easy for an act initiates circulation through willing availability.
Smooth and easy movement makes messenger-mediated obedience a transmitted path rather than a static command.
Succession and linked portions connect response, admission, and provision into one sequence.
Continuing provision gives the flowing rivers a distributive rather than merely scenic function.
Nearness without an intervening gap names the relation that withdrawal abandons.
Turning away severs the proximity and sequence on which circulation depends.
Restraint, withholding, and weaning render punishment as deprivation from the available flow.
Literal painful punishment prevents the deprivation model from dissolving the verse's explicit threat.

changed_reading.before: Reward and punishment are two externally assigned outcomes.
changed_reading.after: They are also two system states: responsive relation opens sustained circulation, while withdrawal ends in enforced withholding and pain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening at 48:1 and the first full garden formula at 48:5 turn the focus's access topology into a surah-scale pattern. Opening a closed entrance and releasing water from an outlet recur as admission into a garden with flowing rivers, so the great opening can be measured by whether constricted bodies are given a route rather than forced through one.

activation_trace.role: An opened closure and widened entrance enlarge the focus's denied constriction into the surah's opening mechanism.
Water bursting from its outlet anticipates the released river-flow that answers bodily bottlenecks.
Denied severe narrowness supplies the local closure that opening reverses.
The earlier literal admission establishes that the focus repeats an inclusion formula, not an isolated decorative promise.
The earlier protected garden makes the focus's destination shared with the larger believing body.
The repeated free-running motion confirms flow as a stable answer to constriction.
A river cutting through ground supplies a traversable channel shared by the earlier and focus promises.

structural_cues: The surah opens with a doubled opening root, while the focus repeats haraj three times.
The sequence 'admit - gardens - flow - beneath - rivers' occurs at 48:5 and again at 48:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opened entrances, released water, denied narrowness, and an exact reward-formula recurrence; I infer that opening is ethically realized as accessible admission and circulation. A primarily military or political opening remains a live alternative rather than being replaced.

changed_reading.before: The no-haraj rule is a local exception within a chapter about a much larger opening.
changed_reading.after: The local rule discloses the quality of that opening: genuine victory widens entry for constrained bodies and releases shared provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first locates settled and growing faith in hearts, then exposes people who plead busyness while their tongues contradict their hearts and whose bad supposition makes them barren. Against that diagnostic field, the named disabilities are certified constraints: the verse protects real incapacity without ratifying verbal pretext or inward withdrawal.

activation_trace.role: Literal blindness anchors a publicly legible constraint rather than a claimed distraction.
Removal of sin grants genuine incapacity a status that contextually false excuses do not receive.
The literal heart identifies the inward site where responsive capacity is assessed.
Heart-settling security supplies a positive interior state independent of bodily power.
Occupation as the opposite of free availability names the competing excuse offered by the stay-behind speakers.
The speech organ supplies the outward claim that can be detached from inward truth.
Present-state negation explicitly marks what their tongues say as absent from their hearts.
The heart is the concealed comparator against which the excuse fails.
Uncertain supposition supplies the inward mechanism behind outward nonparticipation.
Stagnation until corruption gives failed responsiveness a moral texture unlike bodily impairment.

structural_cues: 48:11 presents wealth and family as claimed causes of staying behind, then explicitly separates tongue from heart.
48:12 supplies the concealed bad expectation behind the claim; 48:17 instead names concrete bodily conditions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a speech-heart discrepancy, corrupting supposition, and then unqualified no-haraj for named conditions; I infer a deliberate boundary between incapacity and pretext. A narrower reading in which 48:17 only lists conventional exemptions, without commenting on excuse-making, remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The exemption simply relaxes an otherwise universal demand.
changed_reading.after: The exemption is also diagnostic protection: it prevents genuine bodily limits from being morally confused with strategic speech, bad expectation, or inward refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge scene makes obedience to God and messenger a maintained bond. Its opposite is not mere immobility: breach unravels something previously made firm and harms the breacher, sharpening the focus's turning away into relational disassembly.

activation_trace.role: Mutual accord gives obedience the positive form of maintained alignment.
The messenger and message identify the human relation through which covenantal alignment is enacted.
Turning the back supplies the focus's visible gesture of broken alignment.
A pledge of obedience converts generic compliance into a reciprocal public bond.
Undoing what was firmly tied supplies the material mechanics of turning away.
A preserved covenant supplies the continuity that obedient relation must keep.

structural_cues: 48:10 pairs pledge, breach, self-harm, and fulfillment before the focus pairs obedience, turning, reward, and punishment.
The focus uses a relational verb for refusal rather than a verb of bodily inability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a pledged relation, its unraveling, and the focus's directional turning; I infer that the threat concerns active covenantal disengagement. Generic obedience without a specific pledge remains a materially live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Turning away means failing to perform the commanded act.
changed_reading.after: Turning away means unraveling a maintained relation; a body unable to perform need not have turned at all.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah summons the stay-behind group to fighting and ends with the same obey/turn/punish sequence. The focus then interrupts that sequence with three no-haraj clauses before restating it. This scopes combat performance by bodily capacity while preserving obedience in forms still available.

activation_trace.role: A verbal summons supplies the concrete demand to which capacity must be assessed.
Reciprocal fighting identifies the high-mobility task from which the named bodies are relieved.
The preceding conditional obedience begins the formula that the focus repeats after inserting exemptions.
Repeated withdrawal marks culpable evasion in the precursor formula.
The identical punishment image locks the two ayat into one conditional frame.
The repeated painful quality confirms deliberate restatement rather than loose thematic resemblance.
Removal of prohibition prevents the combat summons from becoming an indiscriminate rule.
Ability inside obedience permits other available responses after combat performance is waived.

structural_cues: 48:16 and 48:17 share obedience, turning away, punishment, and painful language in the same order.
The only major insertion in the repeated frame is the focus's threefold exemption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency, a fighting summons, and near-verbatim conditional repetition; I infer that the insertion calibrates that summons to bodily capacity while leaving a wider field of obedience open. The alternative that every later obedience reference still means participation in the same campaign remains possible but weaker.

changed_reading.before: The disabled are excused from the verse's general moral demand.
changed_reading.after: They are excused from the mobility-intensive combat demand, not removed from moral agency; the repeated conditional resumes on a capacity-sensitive basis.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context repeatedly limits agency: hands are restrained, an objective lies beyond present capacity yet within divine encompassing, and both sides' hands are restrained under divine sight. The focus's bodily nonperformance can therefore no longer be equated with turning away; stopped action may be incapacity, protection, or providential restraint.

activation_trace.role: Loss of sight anchors involuntary limitation at the level of a particular body.
Curtailed motion supplies a second mode in which non-action is not refusal.
The literal hand makes restrained agency bodily and concrete.
Active prevention shows that an unperformed act can result from imposed restraint rather than disloyalty.
Power sufficient to reach action names capacity as a bounded condition, not a moral constant.
Complete encompassing in knowledge holds what lies beyond current human capacity.
Mutual restraint of hands makes nonviolence itself an enacted outcome.
Divine sight supplies the encompassing witness under which human visual and practical limits are judged.

structural_cues: 48:20 and 48:24 repeat restraint of hands, including the believers' own hands.
48:21 explicitly distinguishes present inability from divine encompassing power.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily restraint, acknowledged inability, encompassing knowledge, and divine sight; I infer that the focus distinguishes three externally similar states: refusal, incapacity, and faithful restraint. The context's restrained hands may instead concern strategy alone, but that does not erase the agency distinction it activates.

changed_reading.before: Obedience appears as action, while turning away appears as non-action.
changed_reading.after: Visible non-action is morally underdetermined: it can be bodily incapacity or protective restraint, so only actual withdrawal warrants the threat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hidden believers of 48:25 could be trampled because the community cannot distinguish them; force is withheld until bodies can be separated. This activates the focus's named vulnerable bodies as an epistemic-legal brake: commands affecting bodies must account for persons whom collective vision, classification, or power cannot safely handle.

activation_trace.role: Literal blindness anchors limited human perception in the focus's first protected body.
Removal of culpability supplies the legal effect when bodily realities block safe performance.
Knowledge as disclosure marks the missing information that prevents discriminating action.
A foot pressing a place literalizes the risk that collective movement can crush unseen persons.
Severe pressure turns movement into a causal mechanism of unintended bodily harm.
A stain of harm names the liability produced by undifferentiated force.
Separation and distinction supply the absent condition under which targeted punishment could proceed.

structural_cues: 48:25 explicitly says the believing men and women were not known and could have been trampled unknowingly.
Punishment is counterfactually deferred until populations are distinguished; 48:17 likewise distinguishes bodies before restating punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unseen protected persons, trampling, accidental stain, and a separation condition; I infer that the focus's taxonomy performs the same kind of discriminating restraint at the level of capacity. The alternative that 48:25 explains only a particular historical non-engagement remains live.

changed_reading.before: The verse provides individual accommodations for three familiar disabilities.
changed_reading.after: It also models a collective duty of discrimination: power must pause when its categories cannot see or safely carry vulnerable bodies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The movement from heated group pride to tranquility and binding protective speech makes the exemption part of disciplined strength. The repeated no-haraj clauses cool a martial demand before it can become coercive honor: restraint toward limited bodies belongs to obedience, not to its opposite.

activation_trace.role: Serial negation and acquittal give the three clauses the force of a disciplined public limit.
Removing prohibition prevents martial expectation from hardening into coercive law for impaired bodies.
Heated pride and anger supply the affective pressure that could turn participation into an honor test.
Agitated temperament identifies the unstable social force that tranquility must govern.
Cessation of motion cools reactive momentum and makes restraint an active divine gift.
Binding a rule to people supplies disciplined adherence as the alternative to heated compulsion.
Protection from harm gives the binding word a safeguarding function that extends to the exempt.

structural_cues: The focus follows a battle summons but interrupts it with three acquittals.
48:26 opposes heated collective pride with tranquility and a binding word of protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heat, agitated ignorance, tranquility, binding, and protection; I infer that capacity-sensitive exemption is one legal form of cooling collective pressure. The alternative is that 48:26 concerns only the opposing side's disposition and does not directly govern the exemptions.

changed_reading.before: Exemption is compassionate softness beside a chapter of disciplined force.
changed_reading.after: Exemption is itself disciplined force: it restrains honor-driven coercion and binds the community to protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing plant does not begin upright and thick: a shoot emerges, supports and is supported, then the plant thickens and stands on its stalk. Read back into the lame and sick bodies, communal strength is developmental and relational; supporting reduced capacity is one way the whole body comes to stand.

activation_trace.role: Impaired legs anchor the changed reading in a body that cannot stand or move conventionally.
Weakening and limited motion supply the vulnerable state that support can carry without condemning.
A shoot emerging beside the original makes growth plural and interdependent from the outset.
Weakness being strengthened directly supplies the support relation carried back to the exempt bodies.
Plants strengthening one another turns support into the causal step before thickness and standing.
A body thickening after thinness makes strength an achieved condition rather than an entry requirement.
Upright completion is the result of the support sequence, not proof of prior self-sufficiency.
The load-bearing stalk and leg create a precise material echo of the focus's impaired leg.

structural_cues: The closing image is explicitly sequential: shoot, mutual strengthening, thickening, uprightness, stalk.
The focus's central bodies are defined by sight, gait, and health rather than by exclusion from the believing collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a staged plant mechanism and a branch explicitly naming strengthened weakness; I infer a social analogue in which accommodation contributes to collective uprightness. The plant may alternatively describe communal expansion without any specific disability logic, so the reading remains exploratory.

changed_reading.before: The exemption separates weak members from the community's demanding work.
changed_reading.after: The community's strength may grow through supporting limited members; uprightness is a collective outcome, not a bodily admission test.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the litter and load-bearing branches rather than the ordinary legal sense of haraj. It remains anchored in the repeated haraj, the sick body, and the messenger relation, and downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for obligation, not as a lexical replacement for 'no blame.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verse repeatedly places haraj upon bodies, while packet branches connect laysa with bearing, haraj with a carrying frame, illness with attendance, and messengerhood with gentleness.

activation_trace.role: Forbearance and carrying whatever is loaded activate obligation as a load borne by a person.
A bier or tightly joined carrying frame gives the otherwise abstract burden a material support structure.
Attending to the sick reverses direction: the limited body is to be supported rather than made to carry.
Gentleness and deliberation qualify how messenger-mediated demands should be carried to constrained people.

changed_reading.before: No legal burden is assigned to the disabled.
changed_reading.after: The command is pictured as a carried load: the rule reverses its direction so that constrained bodies receive support rather than becoming supports for the communal burden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the surface 'blind' maps secondarily to an 'amm inventory of generality and collectivity. The packet explicitly supplies that split mapping and the reading remains anchored in the named exception structure; prose should label it a formal activation about general rules, not an etymological claim that 'blind' means 'general.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A serial negation names three particular bodies before the verse returns to the indefinite 'whoever,' creating tension between particular exceptions and general address.

activation_trace.role: Generality and the collective activate the problem of how a universal command lands on unequal bodies.
Exception that removes the named item supplies the formal operation by which particulars qualify a general field.
The prohibition branch identifies what must not be generalized across bodies without distinction.
Capacity restores a differentiated measure inside the resumed general 'whoever' clause.

changed_reading.before: Three exceptions sit outside a general rule.
changed_reading.after: The exceptions govern how generality itself must work: a collective command becomes just only when particular capacities remain visible inside it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The link is surprising because it turns a repeated preposition into a spatial bridge between pledge and reward. It remains valid through the exact 'under' occurrences, the tree's carrying structure, and returned recompense; prose should call it a compositional echo rather than claim that the tree and gardens are identical symbols.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Rivers flow beneath the gardens in the focus, while the next ayah places the pledge beneath a tree and returns an opening as recompense.

activation_trace.role: Literal beneath-space locates sustaining flow under the promised destination.
A watercourse cutting the ground makes the lower space active and provision-bearing.
The repeated beneath-space places the pledge under a living canopy immediately after the focus.
Interlaced load-bearing wood makes the tree a communal support structure rather than mere scenery.
Recompense returning to the actor connects pledged relation under the tree with the focus's promised return.

changed_reading.before: The exemption leads to a future garden, while the tree pledge is a separate scene of able participants.
changed_reading.after: Two under-spaces coexist: covenant is enacted beneath a supporting canopy, and its sustaining return flows beneath the garden; exemption from one act need not mean exclusion from that relational ecology.

strongest_changes: The near-verbatim 48:16/48:17 frame scopes combat by capacity while preserving other forms of obedience.
The false-excuse and heart sequence prevents genuine bodily incapacity from being read as inward refusal.
Restrained hands and hidden believers make visible non-action morally underdetermined and turn discrimination among bodies into a legal safeguard.
The repeated garden formula recasts the surah's opening as accessible admission and released circulation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus became a hinge between martial summons and protective restraint. Its bodily taxonomy did not shrink the surah's opening; it revealed opening as differentiated access, covenant without coercion, and collective strength capable of carrying unequal bodies.
remaining_uncertainties: The access topology may be a productive compositional echo rather than a governing semantic mechanism.
The epistemic-brake reading depends on carrying 48:25's hidden-body logic back into the exemption list.
The plant-support model is strongly branch-activated but remains a cross-domain social inference.
The load-bearing and split-generality outliers should remain explicitly exploratory.
